label: Second copy step (recall_idx 1) of length-9 sequences when re-fed first token is 0, f or z
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit that fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely at step t=10 of length-9 sequences (99% of mass), i.e. the step right after <DEL>, where the input is the fed-back first original token and the output is original token 1. Four of 360 dev activations are at t=9 in L=8 sequences, the same structural slot one step earlier. It never fires in the original phase, on the delimiter, or at any other copy position. Within this slot the input/first token matters most: 0 (43% of mass) and f (34%) dominate, then z (10%), with small amounts on 1, o, n and others. The strongest activations are all on 0 or f. Precision is low even inside the slot (about 17-22%): most L=9 sequences starting with 0/f/z at that step do not fire, and I found nothing in the later original tokens, the digit count or orig(1) that separates them. So the context is captured well but the firing condition inside it is not.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=0 (+4.44), t=10 & in_tok=z (+2.69), t=10 & in_tok=f (+2.33), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=f (+2.19), orig4=w (+1.98), orig5=v (+1.50). Lower it: orig2=p (-1.89), orig8=- (-1.83), orig7=- (-1.75), orig2=o (-1.66).
